title: transport_performance documentation
text:
Where do I go now?
These docs are structured in accordance with the Diátaxis framework:

If you’re looking to get started with the package quickly, head over to the Getting Started page.
For more information on the transport_performance package, refer to the Explanation section.
The How-To pages provide you with instructions on things like retrieving input data.
If you’re interested in learning how to use the package, head over to the Tutorials.
The transport_performance technical reference can be found here: API reference.







Tip



Please refer to our Docker image 🐳 to see how we reproduce analysis with the transport_performance package.
